values.note: Township rate table for R.V. West: hook-up sites $30 a day ($196 a week, $600 a month), seniors 65+ $27 ($176.40 / $540), primitive (tent) sites $25 ($160 / $435); one rate for residents and non-residents. On Campspot (read 2026-10-13): $30 a night for 2 adults on every RV site type a 23-ft rig fits, plus the park's 3% 'Processing Fee' and Campspot's own booking fee at checkout (3%, at least $3). Fees are payable at check-in; no refunds or discounts for early departure.

note: Kinross Township RV park behind Kinross Community Park, home of the Chippewa County Fair, less than a mile off I-75 exit 378; a more rural setting than its sister R.V. Park East, with grass sites off dirt roads and a modern bathhouse. Golf, two swimming/fishing lakes, ORV and equestrian trails nearby. --Claude
